verification.notes: Verified as an attribution claim. The episode contains Trump’s direct Fox & Friends audio, and Fox News independently quotes the same remarks: his preference had always been to take Kharg Island and he did not know whether America had the stomach for it. This verifies that he made the quoted statement; it does not purport to prove a private preference beyond his words.
